Shaping the Future of Auto Lending: Regulation, Innovation & Growth

We sincerely appreciate Ms. Loveena Kansal, Executive Vice President – Business Head, Mega Corporation, for her valuable contribution as a panelist in the insightful discussion on “Shaping the Future of Auto Lending: Regulation, Innovation & Growth” at India’s First Auto Loan & Leasing FinX Banking Conclave, held on August 19th in Mumbai, presented by Qualtech Edge and powered by Park+

Her participation brought valuable perspectives from the financial services and lending ecosystem, adding depth to the conversation around the evolving regulatory environment, innovation and sustainable growth in auto finance.

As India's vehicle finance industry continues to transform through digitalisation, new mobility models, EV adoption and evolving customer expectations, strong industry collaboration and responsible innovation will be key to building a resilient and inclusive lending ecosystem.

Thank you, Ms. Loveena Kansal, for sharing your valuable insights and contributing meaningfully to this important conversation on the future of auto lending in India.

Arun Kumar Manickam
